company_name: Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency Tokyo Trade Center
semiconductor_relevance: Low — KOTRA primarily facilitates business partnerships and trade shows rather than directly supplying semiconductor products or services.
summary: KOTRA (Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency) supports the expansion of Japan-Korea business by promoting Korean small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and facilitating trade shows. They focus on introducing outstanding Korean companies to Japanese markets and providing business support, including import consultation.

regional_presence.Japan: KOTRA has a significant presence in Japan, supporting Korean SMEs in establishing business relationships and facilitating trade.
regional_presence.Korea: KOTRA operates in Korea, promoting the internationalization of Korean companies.
